title.ja: Zalesak型2D回転輸送：保存・有界性・形状誤差
title.en: Zalesak-type 2D rotation: conservation, bounds and shape error

summary.ja: スロット付き円盤を実際の2次元有限体積法で一回転させ、donor-cellとminmod MUSCLを比較します。3格子と、半セルの中心ずらし・45度の初期向きを含む8計算で、保存・各SSP段の有界性・形状誤差とスロットの埋まりを測ります。
summary.en: Rotate a slotted disk through one full turn with an actual 2D finite-volume solver, comparing donor-cell and minmod MUSCL. Eight runs combine three grids with half-cell-center and 45-degree-start probes; measure conservation, bounds at every SSP stage, shape error and slot filling.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の[0,1]²、回転中心(.5,.5)、円盤中心(.5,.75)、半径.15、スロット幅.05・上端y=.85、角速度1、一回転T=2π、32²/64²/128²セルを固定します。スロット以外はq=1、外側は0です。周期境界を使い、厳密な物体の支持は境界から離れます。速度の周期延長には接線成分の継ぎ目があり、数値拡散の裾が届く場合は境界帯の質量として記録します。
assumptions.en: Fix the dimensionless unit square, rotation center(.5,.5), disk center(.5,.75), radius.15, slot width.05/top y=.85, angular speed1, T=2pi and32²/64²/128² cells. The body is1 and exterior/slot0. Periodic normal face velocities match; the exact compact support stays away from the boundary. The periodic extension has a tangential-velocity seam, and diffusive tails reaching its fixed-width boundary band are measured.

algorithm.ja: 解析的な発散ゼロの法線面速度と、隣接セルで共有する上流数値流束を用います。区分定数donor-cellと、方向別minmod勾配による平均保存型MUSCLを、どちらもSSPRK(3,3)で進めます。4面中点の平均がセル平均に等しいことと、各面のCourant数≤1/4による凸結合を使い、実際の値.20を各FE段で確認します。セル平均のクリップ、状態floor、刻み棄却・再試行は行いません。
algorithm.en: Use analytic divergence-free normal face averages and one shared upwind flux per interface. Both piecewise-constant donor-cell and mean-preserving directional-minmod MUSCL use SSPRK(3,3). The four face-midpoint mean equals the cell mean; individual outgoing-face Courant<=1/4 gives a convex FE update. Check the actual .20 bound at every stage. No transported-state clipping/floors or rejected/retried steps are used.

validation.ja: 26単体検査と8固定計算158判定を実行前に固定します。全FE候補・SSP凸結合のmin/max、共有流束による質量収支、再構築の平均保存、3格子のL1/L∞・相対L2を保存します。円と凸多角形の交差面積から独立に作る厳密輸送のセル平均を、SciPyの鉛直切片求積と面積・一次モーメントで照合します。1/4・1/2・3/4回転の誤差と重心も検査し、回転方向や速度の誤りが一回転のreturnだけで隠れないようにします。
validation.en: Freeze26 unit checks and158 gates across eight fixed runs before execution. Retain min/max of every FE candidate/SSP convex mean, shared-flux mass budgets, reconstruction mean preservation and three-grid L1/Linf/relative-L2 errors. Independent circle/convex-polygon intersection means are qualified against SciPy vertical-slice quadrature, total area and first moments. Also check quarter/half/three-quarter-turn errors and centroids so a wrong direction or speed cannot hide behind a full-turn return.

limits.ja: 標準的なスロット形状を単独の0–1物体として使う周期境界の限定例です。Zalesak原著のFCTアルゴリズム、原著の格子・境界、bell/coneを加えたFiredrakeデモ全体の再現ではありません。スロット内の診断は、固定した内側長方形と区分定数セル平均との面積重み付き値です。粗格子では厳密セル平均の投影だけでも0にならないため、その参照baselineと過剰な埋まりを別々に示します。格子中心・45度方向の2診断を普遍的な等方性保証とせず、完全な形状保持や一般流れの最大値原理を主張しません。解析幾何の微小な面積丸め処理と、実際の輸送状態をクリップしないことを区別します。
limits.en: This is an isolated0–1 standard slotted body with periodic boundaries. It does not implement Zalesak FCT, reproduce the original paper’s grid/boundaries or the entire Firedrake bell/cone/background demonstration. The inner-slot diagnostic area-weights piecewise-constant means over a fixed rectangle. Coarse exact cell projection can already give a nonzero baseline, which is reported separately from excess numerical filling. Two center/orientation probes do not establish universal isotropy, perfect shape retention or a maximum principle for arbitrary flows. Tiny geometric-area roundoff handling is distinguished from the absence of transported-state clipping.

formulas: q^{(1)}=E_{\Delta t}(q^n),\quad q^{(2)}=\tfrac34q^n+\tfrac14E_{\Delta t}(q^{(1)}),\quad q^{n+1}=\tfrac13q^n+\tfrac23E_{\Delta t}(q^{(2)})
\frac{\Delta t}{h}\max(|u|,|v|)\le\tfrac14,\quad D_h\!\cdot u=0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad 0\le E_{\Delta t}(\bar q)\le1\ \text{if all four face states lie in }[0,1]

citations.author: Steven T. Zalesak
citations.title: Fully multidimensional flux-corrected transport algorithms for fluids
citations.role: historical slotted-cylinder/FCT source; not the implemented method
citations.review_scope: publisher bibliography and abstract inspected; direct full-paper open returned403; original test geometry and boundary conditions not audited

review.ja: 出版社の書誌と多次元FCTの抄録を確認。原著全文とその格子・境界・具体形状は今回未確認です。本例をZalesakのFCTアルゴリズム再現とは表示しません。
review.en: Publisher record and abstract checked. The full original test geometry/grid/boundaries were not audited. This example does not implement or reproduce Zalesak FCT.

citations.author: Firedrake developers
citations.title: DG advection equation with upwinding
citations.role: actually inspected normalized slotted-disk geometry, rotation velocity and period
citations.review_scope: official documentation equations and source lines46,63–92: disk(.5,.75),R.15,slot(.475,.525),y<.85,velocity(.5−y,x−.5),T2pi; SSP equations43–45 and135–143

review.ja: 公式デモの形状・回転速度・周期とSSPRK式を確認。元デモはbell・coneと背景1を加え、DQ1・流入値1を使います。本例はスロット円板だけの0–1指示関数・有限体積・周期境界という明示的な変形です。Firedrakeは実行・転載しません。
review.en: Inspected official geometry, velocity, period and SSP formulas. The demo includes a bell, cone, background1, DQ1 elements and inflow1. This is an explicit isolated0–1 slotted-disk FV/periodic variant. No Firedrake software was executed or copied.

citations.author: Randall J. LeVeque
citations.title: High-Resolution Conservative Algorithms for Advection in Incompressible Flow
citations.role: conservative scalar-advection and donor-cell/minmod background; official demo attribution
citations.review_scope: author-hosted paper selected sections1–3 actually inspected: PDE/incompressibility, FV means, minmod definition, donor-cell flux; no full-paper or numerical-table reproduction

review.ja: 著者公開論文の節1–3で保存形・非圧縮条件・セル平均・minmod・donor-cellを確認。Firedrakeが標準複合図形の出典として引用しています。本例のMUSCL＋SSPRKは同論文のCTU／波動伝播法そのものではありません。
review.en: Read sections1–3 on conservative transport, incompressibility, means, minmod and donor-cell fluxes. Firedrake cites this paper for its composite-shape test. Our MUSCL/SSPRK update is not the paper’s CTU/wave-propagation algorithm.

citations.author: Chi-Wang Shu and Stanley Osher
citations.title: Efficient implementation of essentially non-oscillatory shock-capturing schemes
citations.review_scope: publisher bibliography/abstract inspected; actual three-stage convex formulas checked in official Firedrake demo, not a full original-paper audit

review.ja: 出版社の書誌とTVD Runge–Kuttaの抄録を確認。使う三段凸結合はFiredrake公式記述でも確認しました。原著全文の監査とは区別します。
review.en: Publisher bibliography/abstract checked; the actual three-stage convex formulas were also inspected in the official Firedrake demo. The original full paper was not audited.

citations.author: SciPy developers
citations.title: scipy.integrate.quad — SciPy v1.14.1 Manual
citations.role: actually executed independent adaptive vertical-section quadrature for geometry qualification
citations.review_scope: official versioned API: QUADPACK integration, break points, epsabs/epsrel, reported error; use is evidenced by qualification receipts

review.ja: 版を固定した公式APIでQUADPACK、分割点、絶対・相対公差と推定誤差の意味を確認。解析的な円・多角形の面積計算とは異なる垂直断面求積を、実行記録付きで照合します。
review.en: Versioned official API checked for QUADPACK, break points, tolerances and reported error. Independently integrated vertical sections are compared with circle/polygon areas; execution is established by saved receipts.
